<!-- pr-reviewer: 54566c83dfd3c471288deb501a8874ac2ba0c627 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one conflict with main, otherwise sound).

**What looks good**
- Safe seam: every post's `onClose()` skips its own home only when the trip home was the last thing written (`linesWritten() === homedAt`). Anything written after it (M5/M9 from `endPreamble()`, a comment) makes the counts differ, so the close home is written as before. The home can only be dropped when the trip home already covers it, and the machine still ends retracted and homed (Fanuc/Haas/Mazak `G91 G28 Z0` + `G28 X0 Y0`, Siemens `G53 Z0` covered by the trip's `G53 Z`, lathe `G28 U0`/`W0`).
- Mid-program homes, Suppress and "Skip pauses and homes" are unchanged and pinned by the new tests.
- `linesWritten()` is documented in `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`; decision record is in `docs/decisions/504-trailing-home.md`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #504`; no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes.

**Local results** (PR head, NOT merged with main because of the conflict below)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test program_entry` | 9 passed |
| `--test posting` | 17 passed |
| `--test conformance` | 6 passed |
| `--test after_op` | 10 passed |
| `camcraft-post` tests | all passed (33 in the largest binary) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge conflict with main in `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` `onClose()` (around line 433). Main (#503) now writes the end-of-program home as `var z = safeZ(); if (z !== null) block(["G53", "Z" + fu(z)]);`, and `afterOp()`'s home (around line 342) now also uses `safeZ()` and returns early when it is refused. Please merge main and keep both: the `linesWritten() !== homedAt` guard wrapping main's `safeZ()` close home. `homedAt` is set only after the trip home is actually written, so a refused safeZ leaves `homedAt` at -1 and the close still reports/handles as main intends. Then re-run `program_entry` and the Siemens goldens, since main changed the Z value those homes use.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The five test-visible posts are covered; Heidenhain and Tormach already refuse a trip home by name, as the PR says.
- Not exercised: a real machine or simulator run, as the PR states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 16d7f71b5127a371ec89c35514460d706bde0735 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Re-review at 16d7f71. The earlier `sinumerik.cps` `onClose()` conflict is resolved correctly.

**What looks good**
- `sinumerik.cps:437-447`: main's `var z = safeZ(); if (z !== null) block(["G53","Z"+fu(z)])` now sits inside `if (linesWritten() !== homedAt)`. The close home is skipped only when nothing was written after the trip home. `homedAt` starts at -1, and `linesWritten()` is never negative, so a program with no trip home always writes its close retract.
- `homedAt` is set only after the trip home was actually written (`sinumerik.cps:349`, after the `safeZ()` null check at 345). If `safeZ()` refuses, `afterOp` returns early and `homedAt` stays unset. `onClose` then calls `safeZ()` again, gets the cached null, writes no retract and adds no second warning. The refusal is the one `safeZ()` already named, as on main; the program does not silently end unretracted. The existing `a_machine_without_a_safe_z_is_refused_by_name` still passes.
- Anything written after the trip home (a tool change, another operation) changes the line count, so the close home is written again. The program-order law holds.
- `linesWritten()` flushes the pending partial line first, so the count is accurate. It is documented in `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`.
- Per-post scripts rather than an app-level drop is the right seam, and the decision record is present.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| suite | result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-app `program_entry` | 9 passed |
| `sinumerik_safe_retract` | 3 passed |
| `tormach_safe_retract` | 4 passed |
| `conformance` | 6 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `after_op` | 10 passed |
| camcraft-post (all targets) | all passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

No build.rs, `.github`, script or dependency changes, so it was built and run.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- No test drives the combination "Siemens, no machine safe Z, trailing Go home". I checked it by reading (see above), and the same path is covered on main by the refusal test. A small pin would be nice but is not needed.
- The Siemens close home and the trip home are both `G53 Z...`, so skipping the duplicate loses nothing there. The trip home also moves X/Y.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
